# MobileFilmLab — first public beta

**Oppo Find X9 Ultra is the primary target.** We plan to expand device compatibility with beta testers' help. Other phones/firmware may expose fewer lenses or processing capabilities; please report what works, what falls back and what fails.

## What's new

- First signed **public-testing beta**, following positive initial owner feedback on alpha.9. This is not a stable release or a claim that every feature/device has been validated.
- Polished README focused on general features, clear installation/testing guidance, device and bug-report forms, documentation index and preserved historical design/test records.
- Actual Android/Compose UI screenshot gallery, using a visibly labelled AI-generated demo scene and illustrative state; not handset captures or camera-quality evidence.
- Explicit AI-assisted/generated-development disclosure in the repository and app About screen.
- Beta-aware manual release checks: newer beta/stable builds, no alpha/RC offers or silent installation. Added channel-selection/asset-identity regression tests.
- Exact-tag publication approval and immutable releases; no blanket approval for future beta or stable tags.

## Included camera workflow

Photos-only AUTO/PRO capture, capability-gated rear lens slots and digital framing, all 77 upstream recipes plus three neutral/vivid/monochrome baselines, live colour previews and Tone/Warmth editing, favourites/custom presets, optional grain, local gallery, recipe-file/QR-image interchange, grids/level and hardware shutter keys.

The working alpha.9 capture implementation is retained. Native captured/cropped dimensions remain the default; unedited, uncropped baseline JPEG pixels are preserved. Optional enlargement is interpolation, not recovered detail. This release does not claim a new image-quality retuning or exact stock-camera reproduction.

## Testing limitations

Advertised OEM HDR/Night, three-frame JPEG fusion and PRIVATE reprocessing ZSL remain experimental/capability-dependent. Per-lens measured calibration, all-firmware compatibility, broad stress/thermal testing and image-quality comparisons remain open. Successful builds/tests do not prove physical-camera behaviour. Keep another camera available for important photographs.

Developed substantially with AI assistance, including generated code, tests, documentation and presentation assets, under human direction. No independent security audit or general reliability guarantee. No analytics or photo uploads; only a manually requested release check uses the network.

## Install and help test

Download `MobileFilmLab-v0.2.0-beta.1-signed.apk` below. It uses the existing `com.mobilefilmlab.camera` package and release certificate, with **versionCode 10**. Install over the alpha to retain app data rather than uninstalling; confirm custom recipe/favourite retention and report any issue.

- `checksums.txt`: APK SHA-256.
- `TESTING.md`: public test checklist and reporting instructions.
